title: ecdf
summary: Compute or plot empirical distribution functions.

gpu_support.notes: Documented floating gpuArray sample data uses an owner-aware host fallback and restores numeric outputs to the source provider. Plotting remains a host graphics sink.

description: `ecdf(y)` computes the empirical cumulative distribution function for numeric sample data. With no requested outputs it plots the empirical function; with outputs it returns column vectors for function values, evaluation points, and confidence bounds.
notes: NaN sample, censoring, and frequency entries are omitted.

Typed-integer or logical sample data, typed-integer or logical Frequency data, and typed-integer Censoring data are separately named RunMat-only extensions. Strict modes reject each role before provider access.
Admitted integer values must be exactly representable at the explicit binary64 statistics boundary; all numeric outputs from an integer extension call are double.

`Censoring` supports fully observed data (`0`), left-censored observations (`-1`), and right-censored observations (`1`). Interval and double-censored Turnbull estimation are reported as unsupported instead of approximated.
`Function`, `"cumulative hazard"` uses Nelson-Aalen cumulative hazard steps for fully observed and right-censored data.
`Alpha` controls pointwise confidence bounds. `Bounds`, `"on"` includes confidence-bound lines when plotting.
Interval-censored EMICM estimation, double-censored Turnbull estimation, and their iteration controls remain explicit implementation gaps and return stable unsupported-form errors.
